RESULTS DRIVEN INVESTMENT REAL ESTATE SERVICES Consistently recognized as one of the top investment real estate service firms in the United States. ABOUT US Relationship Focused Results Driven SERVICES Horvath & Tremblay is a premier real estate services firm specializing in investment real estate brokerage, 1031 exchanges, debt and equity placement, and appraisal and valuation services. Headquartered in Boston, with a nationwide presence spanning 19 offices, the firm has earned a reputation as a trusted partner to thousands of real estate investors and industry professionals. Our experienced team is committed to delivering exceptional service and strategic guidance, helping clients maximize the value of their real estate investments and achieve long-term success. SERVICES DELIVERING UNMATCHED SERVICE & RESULTS H&T AT A GLANCE Our success is defined by the high level of value we provide to our clients and other industry professionals. $0IN RECENT TRANSACTIONS$10B+ IN RECENT TRANSACTIONS 0+TRANSACTIONS ACROSS 44 STATES3,000+ TRANSACTIONS ACROSS 44 STATES 0OFFICES ACROSS THE US19 OFFICES ACROSS THE US OFFICES What We Do More than ever, real estate investors need strong relationships with professionals who can provide accurate market insight and strategic recommendations for their investment portfolios. Horvath & Tremblay is committed to being a leading investment real estate services company, delivering superior results for its clients. Backed by years of experience, national market knowledge, and local expertise, the firm continues to innovate by providing enhanced data, technology, and resources to both its professionals and clients. As a result, Horvath & Tremblay has consistently been recognized among the “Top 10 Best Commercial Real Estate Workplaces in the U.S.” while expanding rapidly to nineteen offices nationwide.
